payload.body: DOCOS -> HARDEN, deterministic repro on design-lap (follow-up to 1f286a2cd report): after the owner updated omp 18.11.0 -> 18.17.0, (1) confined herdr seats first failed because omp 18.17.0 extracts natives to ~/.omp/natives/18.17.0/ on first start and the bwrap seat cannot write host home; screen: 'Cannot find module ...pi_natives.linux-x64-modern.node ... The compiled binary should extract one of: ~/.omp/natives/18.17.0/pi_natives.linux-x64-*.node'. Fixed by running omp once outside the sandbox. Any fgOS user who updates omp will hit this; doctor could check the natives dir for the installed omp version. (2) After that, fgos dispatch probe-account --provider gemini --account tetcu72, 3 runs: omp-herdr = outcome other in 3/3 (11.8-15.1 s; reason terminal:delivery-unknown; screen shows omp v18.17.0 ready UI with 'Gemini 3.8 Flash', then the pane zsh prompt), omp-cli-bwrap = ok in 3/3. So with omp 18.17.0 the herdr path loses the foreground every time, not 6% as with 18.11.0. pi, codex and claude over herdr pass on the same machine and release (0be72b79).
